title: Two-Minute Pitch Structure and Timer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Entrepreneurship
description: Jordan's two-minute founder pitch split into four timed sections on a proportional time bar: Problem (30s), Solution (30s), Evidence (40s) and Ask (20s). A millis()-based 120-second countdown with Start, Pause/Resume and Reset highlights each section in fox-orange as the clock crosses 0:30, 1:00 and 1:40, and a detail panel shows what belongs in the section, Jordan's version of it, and a word budget. Clicking a block or pressing Previous and Next steps through the sections without running the clock.

prerequisites: Chapter 17 reading through The Mini Pitch: Your Two Minutes
A written problem statement, minimum viable offer, and at least one lean test result for one's own idea
educational.topic: Two-minute pitch: organizing a founder pitch into Problem, Solution, Evidence and Ask sections with fixed time budgets
learningObjectives: Apply a four-part structure (Problem, Solution, Evidence, Ask) to organize a two-minute founder pitch
Decide what content belongs in each section, using Jordan's mobile dog-grooming pitch as a worked example
Time a spoken pitch so each section fits its budget and the Ask begins by 1:40

controls.label: Start Pitch Timer / Pause / Resume
controls.purpose: Start the 120-second countdown, pause it, and resume from the same time; after 2:00 it starts a new run from 0:00 (the label shortens to Start on narrow screens)

controls.label: Reset
controls.purpose: Stop the clock and return to 0:00 with no section selected

controls.label: Previous
controls.purpose: Show the previous section in the detail panel without touching the clock (also the left arrow key)

controls.label: Next
controls.purpose: Show the next section in the detail panel without touching the clock (also the right arrow key)

controls.label: Section blocks
controls.purpose: Click Problem, Solution, Evidence or Ask at any time to show that section's prompt and Jordan's version; while the clock runs this is a preview and the panel returns to the live section at the next boundary

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Worked example followed by timed practice with real-time pacing feedback
keyQuestions: Which words in Jordan's Problem line name who has the problem, and what it costs them?
Why does Evidence get the longest time budget?
Where were you in your own pitch when the Ask block turned orange at 1:40?
commonMisconceptions: A pitch is a sales performance rather than a short synthesis of evidence already gathered
The Solution section should list every feature instead of the minimum viable offer
Evidence means enthusiasm or predictions rather than what real customers did
The Ask can be a general request for support instead of a specific, checkable request
assessmentOpportunities: Name the four sections in order with their budgets and start times
Place a given pitch sentence in the correct section and justify the choice
Deliver a timed rehearsal that reaches the Ask by about 1:40 and ends before 2:00
Write an Evidence line that reports observed customer behavior with a number
